Theorem
[Rellich--Kondrachov Compactness Theorem] ↗ def:compact-embedding ↗ thm:sobolev-embedding-w1p-subcritical ↗ thm:sobolev-extension-theorem ↗ thm:local-smooth-approximation 1. ch5:5.7-thm-1\group Compactness

Assume $U$ is a bounded open subset of $\R ^n$, and $\partial U$ is $C^1$. Suppose $1 \le p < n$. Then \[ W^{1,p}(U) \CC L^q(U) \] for each $1 \le q < p^*$.

Proof

\sketch After extension, assume compact support in a fixed bounded set. Mollification converges uniformly in $L^q$ on bounded Sobolev sets, while for fixed mollifier scale the sequence is bounded and equicontinuous; Arzela–Ascoli followed by a diagonal argument gives a convergent subsequence.

□
